ABOUT THE COMPANY: 

 Maven is a market-leading proprietary trading firm allocating internal capital across discretionary, systematic, and market-making strategies. Our collective expertise spans traders, engineers, and technologists, unified by an unwavering dedication to enhance our efficiency as a premier liquidity provider for globally listed derivatives. We leverage groundbreaking execution and pricing technologies to elevate and improve how financial markets operate.

 Overview 

 We are seeking a talented and motivated UI developer) to join our Market Making Technology team.

 You will work closely with our existing UI developers and UX designers to deliver the next generation of Maven's trading applications along with its underlying web platform, component library and design system.

 The role will involve 

 
 UI development

 Delivery of new applications and bringing new functionality to existing apps

 Contributing to our core UI framework, including creation of modular components in React and TypeScript

 Participating in discussions on direction and code review

 Collaboration with backend developers to ensure seamless integration

 Supporting our suite of trading applications by troubleshooting, debugging and fixing UI related issues

 
 Must have skills and experience 

 
 Excellent UI development skills in JavaScript/TypeScript, including component and library development

 Proven experience and a keen interest in UX and UI design principles

 Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail

 Pragmatic self-starter with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines

 
   Desirable / nice to have 

 
 Experience with React, component libraries and design systems

 Experience working on complex and data rich user interfaces running across multiple desktops

 Experience working in the financial sector

 Experience using AI-powered tools to improve efficiency and workflows.

 
 WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU 

 
 Competitive compensation 

 Group Pension plan 

 Annual discretionary bonus 

 Fully catered breakfast, lunch and snacks. 

 25 days’ annual leave

 Informal dress code 

 Private healthcare and life assurance

 Cycle-to-work scheme

 Monthly company events
